title: 94-Year-Old Jewish Human Rights Barrister Arrested in UK for Supporting Palestine Action
detail: Margaret Owen OBE, a 94-year-old Jewish human rights barrister, was arrested in the UK for supporting Palestine Action, spotlighting growing civil liberties tensions over pro-Palestinian activism and protest rights. The arrest drew widespread attention amid ongoing UK debates over the right to protest in solidarity with Gaza.

media.caption: Margaret Owen OBE, 94-year-old Jewish human rights barrister arrested in Liverpool for supporting Palestine Action
